series.summary: L airs a decoy broadcast with death-row inmate Lind L. Tailor to provoke Kira into killing him, successfully narrowing Kira's identity and location to the Kanto region of Japan.

title: L Traps Kira on Live Television Part 1

cuts.voiceover_text: The world's most elusive detective just stepped into the spotlight... but this live broadcast is a deadly trap. An emergency Interpol transmission suddenly interrupts television programming across Japan. A man appears in the studio center, introducing himself as Lind L. Tailor, the legendary investigator known as L. He stares directly down the camera lens and vows to hunt down the vigilante Kira. In his bedroom, Light Yagami watches in shock as his anonymous challenger declares war on live television.

On screen, Tailor points directly at the camera and condemns Kira as an evil, cowardly monster. That single word instantly shatters Light's calm composure into furious arrogance. Light proclaims himself the rightful god of a new world, refusing to let anyone question his divine justice. He pulls out the Death Note from his drawer, grabs his pen, and angrily writes Lind L. Tailor's name across the page. He plans to eliminate his rival before the broadcast even ends.

Light watches the television screen with a cold, mocking smile. He counts down the final seconds until the forty second heart attack rule takes effect. Suddenly, Tailor's voice chokes mid-sentence. The detective grabs his chest in visible agony and gasps for breath. He slumps forward and collapses dead on the broadcast desk in front of millions of stunned viewers. Light laughs aloud in wicked triumph, convinced that he has just executed the world's greatest detective.

Moments after the body collapses, the live video feed suddenly cuts to black. A bold gothic letter L flashes across the blank screen. A modulated voice begins to speak through the studio speakers. The real L calmly reveals that the man who just died was actually a condemned death row inmate scheduled for execution today.The entire broadcast was a calculated setup. L taunts Kira directly, daring the killer to strike him down next if he truly has divine power.

Light stares in mounting horror as L delivers the fatal revelation. This broadcast was never aired worldwide. It was transmitted exclusively to Japan's Kanto region as targeted bait. Because Kira struck, L now knows with absolute certainty that Kira is real, kills remotely, and lives right in Kanto. The detective vows to drag him to the gallows. Can Light outsmart the one genius who just pinpointed his location?
